_comment: Structure: years -> semesters -> subjects -> items. A subject is a folder (e.g. assets/guides/year-1/sem-1/cc104/); every subjects array starts empty — publish from /admin.html and it lands here automatically. Subject shape: {id, code, title, items: []}. Each item is one numbered week or freeform 'special' entry inside that subject: {id, kind: "week"|"special", label, order, week?, html?, pdf?} — week/html/pdf are all optional (week only on kind:"week"; html/pdf are paths relative to this file, an item needs at least one of them). order controls sidebar/library sort order. Nothing in script.js needs to change when subjects or items are added — manual editing works too.
